name: basalt-core-demo
description: The demo app this host renders. react, react-native and metro resolve out of the React Native checkout that scripts/bootstrap.sh already set up, so there is nothing here for them. A third-party native module has no such home: storage.tsx imports @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, which is installed into e2e/node_modules by scripts/test_all.sh and by CI, and is gitignored. See metro.config.js.
